value.residual: The retained InMemory store exercises a general owner-version compare-and-swap envelope, stale-writer rejection, no-partial-effect behavior, and stable replay receipts. The canonical Turso adapter's persistence-failure rollback and reopen tests were removed in #2764 (not currently covered). Legacy callers still use the unversioned compatibility method, Postgres parity and a transport TransitionEnvelope remain open, and the Verus reference has no extracted correspondence proof. Public scope excludes the former engine/provider implementation and its evidence; no correspondence is claimed for that omitted code. The extracted compare-and-swap core (crates/norn-kernel/src/commit_versions.rs first_conflict) is proved, for every host lookup and every commit, to read each read then each write expectation in order and report the first stale one (key, expected, current) or the first host error, reading nothing after it (scripts/verify-kernel-commit-aeneas.sh, #718 P8 K-A); the host version lookup and the expectation lists check_versions builds are not covered by that theorem.
